messages:
Ava Growth: Quick ask — can we reallocate some search budget tomorrow and run a 3-headline split on high-intent queries? Need results by EOD Thu so growth can decide Q3 split.
Marcus Paid: +1. Which keywords are you thinking? I can push a change at 10am and set a 48h automated rule. :rocket:
Ben Analytics: FYI last 7d: branded queries CPA = $8.2, non-branded high-intent (try|how to|best) CPA = $42. If we shift, recommend moving from low-conv generic terms first.
Ava Growth: Good call. Let's pull 25% from generic 'llm api' and 'inference platform' broad match and push to exact-match high-intent. Also shorten retargeting window for site visitors from 30d -> 14d for the ad set tied to the new creative.
Marcus Paid: I can do 25% reallocation. Will create two ad groups: "HI-intent-exact" and "Creative-test-A/B/C". Schedule: change goes live 10:00 PT. Auto-bid on for exact, manual bids for test groups.
Priya Creative: Pushing 3 headline sets now. Short, benefit-led. Drafts below: 
```
H1-A: Ship LLM features faster — predictable inference
H1-B: Cut inference costs, keep quality — Redwood Inference
H1-C: Production-grade LLM serving for engineers
Desc: Fast API, dedicated capacity & private deploys. Free trial.
```
Marcus Paid: Nice. I'll attach H1-A to group A, H1-B to B, H1-C to C. We'll rotate evenly. Can someone confirm UTM and landing variants?
Ava Growth: Use utm_source=google&utm_campaign=q3_search_pulse&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={headline_variant}. Use LP v2 (features->pricing quick anchor).
Ben Analytics: I'll spin up a short GA4 segment and dashboard for the test. Metrics: conv rate, CPA, and token-cost-per-api-call (we can map usage from the trial signups). Will share a link when ready.
campaign-bot: Scheduled change deployed at 10:00 PT. Campaign: q3_search_pulse. Rule: pause generic terms if CPA > $60 over 24h.
Marcus Paid: Also enabling a soft budget cap shift: move up to +20% daily budget if CTR lifts >15% and conv rate stable. If CPA spikes, roll-back to baseline.
Priya Creative: Minor variants for ad copy to test explicit ROI vs engineering messaging. Will add one with a numerical claim and one with a developer testimonial.
Ben Analytics: If the high-intent group gets >50% of conversions after 48h, we'll keep the allocation and increase bids by 10%. Otherwise revert.
Ava Growth: Thanks team — timeline: go live 10:00 PT, first check ~24h, decision at EOD Thu. Ping me in this thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
